verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own pages show incorporation work for startups. Fenwick Labs cites "automated generation of incorporation documents for new startups," the Startup Resource Center covers stages "from formation" and "incorporation stage issues," and the startup/VC practice represents 1,500+ VC-backed companies. Founder equity vesting also appears as a core startup topic. Missing for 10: explicit enumeration of charter, bylaws, initial board consents and founder stock purchase agreements as practice deliverables; a practice-page statement that formation is a core service; independent or hands-on corroboration.
